Method of Attack: Targets vulnerable D-Link routers using a mix of old and new exploits
Leverages critical vulnerabilities in D-Link devices for remote code execution
Fetches malware binary using arbitrary commands
Registers captured routers on threat actor’s C2
Attack Vector: Exploitation of critical vulnerabilities in D-Link devices (CVE-2015-2051, CVE-2018-6530, CVE-2022-26258, CVE-2022-28958)
Remote code execution via SOAP interface and HNAP SOAPAction header
